# Chromaprint `fpcalc`

Windows build of [Chromaprint](https://acoustid.org/chromaprint) `fpcalc` used for AcoustID fingerprinting.

Source: https://github.com/acoustid/chromaprint/releases (`chromaprint-fpcalc-*-windows-x86_64.zip`)

Place `fpcalc.exe` in this folder for local development. The GUI/EXE build bundles it automatically.
